setting_showFrametimes_help.message:
The measured display framerate is not a reflection of the real performance.
Because the measurement uses an extra percentage of CPU usage.
However, this statistic could be helpful to debug other issues.

setting_frameSync_help.message:
How much energy will be spent on synchronising ambient light frames with video frames.

Decoded framerate: Lowest CPU & GPU usage.
Might result in dropped and delayed frames.

Display framerate: Highest CPU & GPU usage.
Might still result in delayed frames on high refreshrate monitors (120hz and higher) and higher than 1080p videos.

Video framerate: Lowest CPU & GPU usage.
Uses the newest browser technology to always keep the frames in sync.

setting_energySaver_help.message:
Limits the framerate on videos with an (almost) static image

Still image: 1 frame per 5 seconds
Small movements: 1 frame per second

setting_prioritizePageLoadSpeed_descript.message: Loads the ambient light after the page has loaded

setting_layoutPerformanceImprovements_de.message: Improves the responsiveness of the webpage

setting_layoutPerformanceImprovements_he.message:
Some of the improvements on the /watch page include:
- Faster webpage resizing and scrolling (Most noticeable after you've loaded in more than 100 comments)
- Faster loadingtimes for comments and/or related videos
- Smoother timeline scrubbing (Most noticeable after you've loaded in more than 100 comments or with a livestream chat window open)
- Smoother livestream chat scrolling (and new messages will be appended quicker to the chat)
- Smoother playlist scrolling (Most noticeable in a playlist with more than 25 videos)
- Smoother dragging/re-ordering videos in a playlist (Most noticeable in a playlist with more than 25 videos)

setting_debandingBlendMode_help.message:
The normal blend mode is useful to fix banding in dark colors on LCD's.
But on OLED's it's better to use the "overlay" blend mode to retain pure blacks.

setting_surroundingContentTextAndBtnOnly.message: Shadows on texts and buttons only

setting_videoDebandingStrength_help.message:
Click for more information about debanding (noise /dithering).
Tip: Change the "Quality > Optimize debanding for" setting to "OLED" to retain pure blacks on OLED displays.

setting_videoOverlayEnabled_help.message:
Delays the video frames according to the ambient light frametimes.
This makes sure that the ambient light is never out of sync with the video,
but it can introduce stuttering and/or dropped frames.

setting_chromiumBugVideoJitterWorkaround.message:
Chromium has a bug that jitters the video playback when your display 
has a higher framerate than 60Hz. This workaround prevents the jittering 
by forcing the browser to run at the framerate of your display instead. 
Click the questionmark for more information about this bug in Chromium browsers.

setting_chromiumDirectVideoOverlayWorkar.message:
This workaround must be disabled for 
NVidia RTX Virtual Super Resolution (VSR)

This workaround can fix several artifacts/bugs,
when videos are in hardware accelerated overlays (MPO).
Examples are: random black/white squares, flickering or a squeezed video.

Click on the questionmark for more and updated information about these artifacts/bugs.

setting_barSizeDetectionAverageHistorySi.message:
The amount of video frames to detect an average bar size from. 
A lower amount of frames results in a faster detection, 
but does also increase the amount of inaccurate detections.

setting_barSizeDetectionAllowedElementsP.message:
At 10% only clear bars are removed.
A higher percentage can also remove bars with some elements.
And an even higher percentage can crop to a squared element in the center.

setting_barSizeDetectionAllowedUnevenBar.message:
Higher percentages detect a more uneven bar.
For example: A bar is uneven when the top bar is smaller than the bottom bar.
But with a high percentage you also increase the risk that straight objects or lines are seen as bars.

setting_edge_description.message: To better see what changes: Turn the blur to 0%

setting_spreadFadeCurve_description.message: To better see what changes: Turn the blur to 0%

setting_debandingStrength_help.message:
Click for more information about (noise /dithering).
Tip: Change the "Quality > Optimize debanding for" setting to "OLED" to retain pure blacks on OLED displays.

setting_frameFading_help.message: Fading between changes in the ambient light

setting_flickerReduction_help.message: Reduces flickering by limiting the speed at which brightness changes in the ambient light

setting_frameBlending_description.message: Uses: GPU power. Also works with "Sync video"

setting_frameBlending_help.message: Click for more information about Frame blending

setting_fixedPosition_description.message: Ignores the scroll position of the page

warning_settings_load_slow.message:
It is taking more than 5 seconds to load your previous settings.
If this is your first warning and it does not disappear, then the extension might have updated. 
You can reload the webpage to complete the update.

But if this happens frequently, here are some possible causes:
- Another extension is blocking code execution on this webpage for a long duration.
  Disable other extensions temporarily to find out which one it is.
- If your computer is very slow or frequently freezing in other applications as well,
  there could be a problem with your hardware, likely the memory (DDR).

warning_crash_tips.message:
Reload the webpage to try it again.

Possible causes:
- The memory of your GPU is fully used by another application.
- You have too many YouTube webpages visible at the same time. Your GPU can only render a limited amount of ambient lights at the same time.
- You have changed a setting to a value that is incompatible with your GPU. Undo your last change and refresh the webpage. Or reset all settings with the reset button at the top right.

warning_crash_tips_webgl.message: Another possible workaround could be to turn off the "$ARG1$" setting (This is an advanced setting). But if you do so, know that the legacy renderer requires more power.
